**Findings:**
- v3.4.0 (this morning's deploy) was unhealthy in production with an **18% error rate** across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west)
- v3.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production

**Current state:** payments-worker on v3.3.0 is **healthy** in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.

The v3.4.0 regression still needs root-cause investigation before it's redeployed — on-call has the incident for follow-up.
